acquisitionIntro: Gender Diary runs in a browser. It opens straight away, with nothing to install and no account to make.
acquisitionAndroid: There is no Android app yet. When there is one, these four are the ways we mean to offer it, and none of them is the one we recommend. Each becomes a link here once that channel works.

channels.name: Aurora
channels.note: Aurora installs the same package as Google Play. It is a different way to get that package, not a different build.

channels.name: F-Droid
channels.note: F-Droid would carry it in the main repository, and it builds what it distributes from source itself rather than taking a finished file from us.

channels.name: Google Play
channels.note: Installing from Play means Google knows the app is on your phone.

channels.name: Obtainium
channels.note: Obtainium follows this project's GitHub Releases and installs the signed release APK. It picks that file by name, which is what stops a debug or unsigned build being installed instead. The first release fixes the address of the page and the name of the file.
